title: ProcessReference 2.0: established suspension-culture setpoints, whatever the target cell
description: Physical setpoints of stirred or suspension culture of human iPSC and their derivatives (temperature, dissolved oxygen, seeding density, feed exchange, agitation) are largely shared across target cell types, and a protocol should not leave them blank because no paper about this exact cell states them. Each entry is either `cited` -- with at least one source and the quoted passage it rests on -- or `convention`, a value so standard in mammalian culture that a citation would add nothing (37 degC). An entry fills a protocol gap only as a design_choice a person approves, never as a reported value. Agitation in rpm is vessel-specific: an entry that names no vessel applies anywhere only at low confidence.

typical.description: The value a source uses, or the convention. Never an average of different sources.

vessel.description: e.g. 'spinner flask 125 mL'; required for an agitation entry to apply above low confidence
